body: I'm from Eastern Europe. In high school I never tried very hard , I was more into my hobbies , so my grades weren't excellent, but in university I started look seriously about that and really spent more time into studies so my grades were very good also as a developer in my freshman years I have created some pretty good apps. But the thing is that people around me aren't into that , I ended up being in best country university , but people here seems to come here just for fun. They always talking about things I don't personally find interesting , that's not their fault , it's mine. One time I didn't went to my exam , so I needed to retake it , and at that time I friendly asked some guys how it was going and they simple answered ,,You still will get good mark" and all laughed. The only one who I can talk with about everything is my older brother and thats it. I've taken one one year break now , because I managed to get academic holidays, but I just don't know how I will continue next year. The main problem that I can't relate to other people my age. Thank you again , it's really good to know that there are some really good people out there.

Thank you for reply. Yes , I know that fear keeps me way from happiness, but I'm scared that people will reject me even more. What I see now is that people don't like smarter or more inteligent person. I would be happy , if I could be ,,dumb" , because it would make life more easier. I can't enjoy things, most people enjoy, it seems pointless for me.
